meta.defaultDescription: Shri Gajanan Seva is a 501(c)(3) non-profit in the Bay Area, California, rooted in the teachings of Shri Gajanan Maharaj of Shegaon. Daily seva, utsav, and community service.

home.heroEyebrow: Shri Gajanan Seva · Bay Area, California
home.heroSubtitle: A community rooted in seva — selfless service — and in the teachings of Shri Gajanan Maharaj of Shegaon.
home.liveNowBody: Daily seva is being broadcast on Zoom right now.
home.todayClosed: The mandir is not open for darshan today.
home.todayClosedBody: We are open every Thursday, Saturday and Sunday. Daily seva continues online.
home.upcomingBody: Utsav, upasana and seva drives through the year.
home.donateBody: Every meal served, every blanket distributed, every utsav is carried by devotee generosity.
home.connectBody: Announcements, darshan timings and utsav updates — on the channel that suits you.
home.welcomeBody: Everyone is welcome, whatever your background or familiarity. Here is what to expect on your first visit.

visit.title: Visit the mandir
visit.mapLabel: Map showing the location of Shri Gajanan Seva
visit.mapFallback: Interactive map could not be loaded. Use the directions link below.

dailySeva.title: Daily Seva
dailySeva.intro: Seva is offered every day, in person at the mandir and online on Zoom. You are welcome to join any part of it.
dailySeva.zoomNote: The same Zoom link is used every day. Save it once.
dailySeva.jaapBody: Gan Gan Ganat Bote — the nam given by Maharaj himself.

occasions.title: Occasions
occasions.intro: Utsav, monthly upasana and seva drives through the year.
occasions.rsvpNote: RSVP helps us plan prasad and seating.

library.title: Library
library.intro: Texts, audio, video and newsletters — everything in one place, in both English and Marathi where available.

getInvolved.title: Get Involved
getInvolved.intro: The mandir runs entirely on volunteer seva. There is a place for every skill and every amount of time.
getInvolved.studentsIntro: High school students earn verified community service hours through seva at the mandir.

donate.title: Donate
donate.intro: Shri Gajanan Seva is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent permitted by law.
donate.coverFeesNote: This lets your full gift reach the seva.
donate.onlineUnavailable: Online card giving is not live yet
donate.onlineUnavailableBody: We are completing the setup of our payment processor. In the meantime, Zelle, Venmo and check reach the seva with no processing fee at all.
donate.zeroFeeNote: Zelle and check carry no processing fee — the full amount reaches the seva.
donate.matchingBody: Many Bay Area employers match employee donations, often dollar for dollar. Use the details below in your company's giving portal.
donate.receiptNote: A receipt is emailed for every gift. Annual consolidated statements are available in your account.

connect.title: Connect
connect.intro: Choose how you would like to hear from us.
connect.whatsappGroupBody: Conversation, coordination and seva requests among devotees.
connect.whatsappChannelBody: Announcements only. One-way, no group chatter.
connect.newsletterBody: Sent on the last day of every month — utsav news, seva reports and upcoming dates.
connect.consentLabel: Yes, email me the monthly newsletter. I can unsubscribe at any time.
connect.consentRequired: Please tick the consent box so we can email you.
connect.subscribeSuccess: Almost there — check your inbox and click the confirmation link.
connect.subscribeError: We could not complete that just now. Please try again, or email us directly.
connect.contactSuccess: Thank you. We have your message and will reply soon.
connect.contactError: We could not send that just now. Please email us directly.
connect.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

portal.title: My Account
portal.signInIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a sign-in link. No password to remember.
portal.linkSent: Check your email for a sign-in link.
portal.noRsvps: You have not registered for any occasion yet.
portal.noGiving: No donations are recorded against this account yet.
portal.showAtGate: Show this code at the gate
portal.demoBanner: Demonstration mode — this account uses sample data. No real information is stored.
